note: Mentors and apprentices (spec section 15). Authored by tools/gen script in the slice; edit the JSON freely.

personalities.text: Ambitious and a little ruthless about it.
Gentle, loyal and quick to blush.
Bookish; quotes the manual at the worst moments.
Cheerful in a way that makes rivals suspicious.
Stubborn enough to win a staring contest with a Snorlax.

mentors.name: Captain Ravi Ironhand
mentors.title: The Drill Captain
mentors.background: Led a coastal guard unit for twenty years before turning to training. Believes every battle is won in the week before it.
mentors.personality: Stern, fair and allergic to excuses.
mentors.weakness: Has little patience for care and comfort.
mentors.teaching: Drills that make your attacks land harder.

lessons.name: Footwork Drills
lessons.text: Hold your ground and strike first.

lessons.name: The Clean Finish
lessons.text: End fights fast, before they end you.

lessons.name: Captain's Order
lessons.text: Gym leaders fall to a plan, not luck. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Veteran's Stance
lessons.text: A former apprentice never forgets the stance.

lines.greet: Eyes up. We start at the first bell.
lines.praise: That was clean. Do it again.
lines.scold: Sloppy. We drill it until it is not.
lines.disagree: You think resting wins fights? Rest after the badge.
lines.graduate: You do not need me to say it. Go and win.

mission.name: The Captain's Test
mission.text: Win the next 2 gym battles without being told twice.

graduation.title: Ironhand's Pupil
graduation.text: Ravi salutes you. It is the only salute he gives.

story.intro: Ravi stares at the horizon. "Twenty years on the coast, and I lost one recruit to a storm I should have seen. I teach so no one else is unprepared."
story.listen: You stay quiet and let him finish. He nods once.
story.share: You tell him about your own near miss. "Then we both learned it," he says.

mentors.name: Marigold Hatch
mentors.title: The Nest Keeper
mentors.background: Runs a daycare on a hilltop farm. Has hatched more Eggs than anyone in three regions and names every one.
mentors.personality: Warm, teasing and impossible to hurry.
mentors.teaching: Care techniques that grow bonds and speed up hatching.

lessons.name: A Warm Hand
lessons.text: Pokémon grow where they feel safe.

lessons.name: The Nest Rule
lessons.text: A hatchling learns twice as fast beside a friend.

lessons.name: Rest Is a Move
lessons.text: Rest after a battle is part of the battle. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Heirloom Recipe
lessons.text: Old hands pass on a recipe for strong tea.

lines.greet: Sit, sit. Nobody grows on an empty stomach.
lines.praise: See how it leans on you? That is trust.
lines.scold: You pushed it too far, dear. Look at it.
lines.disagree: There is no hurry that is worth a tired Pokémon.
lines.graduate: My little nest empties and I am proud. Come visit.

mission.name: A Full Nest
mission.text: Reach 2 gym badges while your lead stays friendly.

graduation.title: Hatch's Fledgling
graduation.text: Marigold presses a spare Egg basket into your hands.

story.intro: Marigold turns an Egg in her hands. "My first hatchling never came out. I kept the shell. I have raised every one since like it was that one."
story.listen: You hold the Egg for a moment so she can breathe.
story.share: You tell her about your first Pokémon. She laughs, and wipes her eye.

mentors.name: Dr. Linden Vale
mentors.title: The Field Scholar
mentors.background: A lab dropout who found the field more honest. Fills notebooks with sketches of everything that moves.
mentors.personality: Curious, distracted and generous with credit.
mentors.specialty: Studying Pokémon so battles are never a surprise.
mentors.weakness: Not a fighter; gives no direct combat strength.

lessons.name: Field Notes
lessons.text: Write it down and it becomes knowledge.

lessons.name: Reading the Gym
lessons.text: Study a leader and you know their team.

lessons.name: The Wild Index
lessons.text: Know what waits on the road before you walk it. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Cited Work
lessons.text: A graduate is quoted in the next edition.

lines.greet: Hold still, I want to sketch that stance.
lines.praise: Fascinating! You did exactly what the data said you would not.
lines.scold: You skipped the observation phase again.
lines.disagree: We have not collected enough data to decide.
lines.graduate: I will cite you. Do not make it embarrassing.

mission.name: A Complete Survey
mission.text: Clear 2 gyms with your notes in hand.

graduation.title: Vale's Co-Author
graduation.text: Linden adds your name to the cover of the field guide.

story.intro: Linden closes the notebook. "The lab wanted results. I wanted answers. They were not the same thing, so I left."
story.listen: You ask what answer they found. "That the question was better," they say.
story.share: You share your own odd observation. Linden writes it down, and credits you.

mentors.name: Juno Trailwind
mentors.title: The Trailblazer
mentors.background: Has walked every route twice and some of them backwards. Trades maps for stories.
mentors.personality: Restless, funny and good at silences.
mentors.specialty: Shortcuts, hidden spots and rare finds.
mentors.weakness: Takes risks a careful trainer would not.
mentors.teaching: Trail knowledge: rarer finds and better odds on the road.

lessons.name: Trail Sense
lessons.text: The road tells you what lives on it.

lessons.name: Off the Path
lessons.text: Rare things hide where people do not look.

lessons.name: The Long View
lessons.text: From the top you see every road at once. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Legend of the Road
lessons.text: A graduate hears the old routes calling.

lines.greet: Boots on. The road does not wait.
lines.praise: Now you are reading the ground. Good.
lines.scold: You walked right past it. Look again.
lines.disagree: The safe way is a map. I prefer the unmarked way.
lines.graduate: Go find a road I have not walked, then tell me.

mission.name: The Unmarked Route
mission.text: Find your way to 2 badges with the trail as your guide.

graduation.title: Trailwind's Heir
graduation.text: Juno hands you her oldest compass.

story.intro: Juno traces a route in the dirt. "I was lost for nine days once. A wild Pokémon walked me out. I have been paying it back ever since."
story.listen: You let the silence sit. Juno hums an old trail song.
story.share: You tell her about your wrong turn. "Best way to learn a road," she says.

mentors.name: Celeste Ribbon
mentors.title: The Grand Festival Star
mentors.background: Won three Grand Festivals and retired to teach style. Insists a move is only good if it looks good.
mentors.teaching: Performance technique: accurate status moves and charm.

lessons.name: Strike the Pose
lessons.text: Confidence is half of a move.

lessons.name: Perfect Timing
lessons.text: A status move that lands on time wins the room.

lessons.name: The Grand Finale
lessons.text: Always finish with something unforgettable. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Encore
lessons.text: Past apprentices still get an encore.

lines.greet: Chin up. The audience is watching, even when it is empty.
lines.scold: That was effective but dull. Again.
lines.graduate: Take your bow. You earned it.

graduation.title: Ribbon's Star
graduation.text: Celeste pins her ribbon to your sleeve.

story.intro: Celeste lowers her voice. "I won my third Festival with a shaking hand. Nobody saw. I teach so others know that shaking is allowed."
story.listen: You say nothing and hand her a glass of water.
story.share: You admit you are nervous too. She squeezes your shoulder.

mentors.name: Sable Oakridge
mentors.title: The Retired Champion
mentors.background: Held the title for nine years and left it on a Tuesday. Never explained why.
mentors.weakness: Old wounds: an apprentice who disappoints cuts deep.
mentors.teaching: Champion's temperament: staying calm when it counts.

lessons.name: Quiet Mind
lessons.text: Panic is the only real opponent.

lessons.name: Big Stage
lessons.text: The brighter the room, the slower you move.

lessons.name: The Empty Throne
lessons.text: A title is a weight, not a prize. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: A Champion's Word
lessons.text: A graduate's name opens doors.

lines.greet: I am not here to be impressive. Let us begin.
lines.praise: That is how a champion thinks.
lines.disagree: I once ignored advice like that. I do not recommend it.
lines.graduate: I have waited a long time to say this. Well done.

mission.name: The Last Tuesday
mission.text: Take 2 gym badges to prove you are ready.

graduation.title: Sable's Successor
graduation.text: Sable finally tells you why they left.

story.intro: Sable looks at their hands. "I left the title because I stopped enjoying it. I was afraid that meant I had stopped being good."
story.share: You say you are afraid of the same thing. "Good. Remember that," Sable says.

mentors.name: Dax Corvane
mentors.title: The Rival Who Teaches
mentors.background: A rival trainer who lost to you once and decided that the best way to beat you was to make you better.
mentors.weakness: Everything is a contest, including friendship.
mentors.unlockText: Reach trust 30 with Captain Ravi Ironhand.
mentors.teaching: Rival drills: harder training, bigger rewards.

lessons.name: Sparring Partner
lessons.text: Beat me and you beat anyone.

lessons.name: Useful Grudge
lessons.text: A little spite is good fuel.

lessons.name: Earned Respect
lessons.text: The best compliment is a rematch. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Rematch Rights
lessons.text: Graduates may challenge him any time.

lines.greet: Do not smile. This is a rivalry, not a lesson.
lines.praise: Fine. That was... good. Do not let it go to your head.
lines.scold: You are better than that! Prove it!
lines.disagree: We are not friends. We are better than friends.
lines.graduate: I am not crying. It is the wind. Now race me.

graduation.title: Corvane's Equal
graduation.text: Dax finally calls you by name instead of "rival".

story.intro: Dax scuffs his boot. "I lost to you and I was furious for a week. Then I realised I had never been that interested in anything before."
story.listen: You do not mention the loss. He looks grateful.
story.share: You admit the win was luck. "Liar," he says, grinning.

mentors.name: Brook of Tidewater
mentors.title: The Tidewater Gym Leader
mentors.background: Keeps a water gym by a harbour and still fixes the roof herself. Takes teaching as seriously as her badge.
mentors.specialty: Specialising in one type and doing it well.
mentors.teaching: Type mastery: pick a type and own it.

lessons.name: Read the Tide
lessons.text: Water takes the shape of whatever holds it.

lessons.name: What a Badge Means
lessons.text: A badge is a promise to teach.

lessons.name: The Safe Harbour
lessons.text: A good gym leader also knows when to stop. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Lighthouse Duty
lessons.text: Graduates keep a light on for the next apprentice.

lines.greet: One type. Done properly. That is the whole lesson.
lines.scold: Do not fight the current. Use it.
lines.graduate: You are ready for my gym, or your own.

mission.name: A Badge to Teach
mission.text: Win 2 gym badges using one type as your core.

graduation.title: Brook's Understudy
graduation.text: Brook hands you a spare gym key, just in case.

story.intro: Brook watches the tide. "My mother kept this gym. When the harbour flooded, we saved the Pokémon first. I took her badge, not her name."
story.listen: You listen to the water with her.
story.share: You tell her about your home. "Then you know what a harbour is," she says.

mentors.name: Vesper Nox
mentors.title: The Fourth of the Four
mentors.background: Sits at the end of the Elite Four and hates being the last obstacle. Teaches to find someone who can beat them.
mentors.weakness: Holds apprentices to an impossible standard.
mentors.teaching: Elite tactics: predicting the enemy and turning their plan.

lessons.name: Patient Trap
lessons.text: A good plan costs nothing until it is needed.

lessons.name: Punish the Habit
lessons.text: Everyone repeats themselves. Wait for it.

lessons.name: The Last Door
lessons.text: The final door is only locked from the inside. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: Second Curtain
lessons.text: A graduate is shown the other half of the plan.

lines.greet: Do not tell me your plan. Show me your second plan.
lines.praise: Elegant. I almost did not see it.
lines.scold: You telegraphed that. A child could read it.
lines.disagree: Brave is not the same as correct.
lines.graduate: Come find me at the end of the hall. Bring a better plan.

mission.name: The Fourth Door
mission.text: Defeat 2 gym leaders with a plan worth admiring.

graduation.title: Nox's Successor
graduation.text: Vesper bows. The theatre goes quiet.

story.intro: Vesper adjusts their cloak. "Every challenger who reaches me is better than I was. I teach because I would like, once, to lose well."
story.listen: You nod. Vesper turns away, but not before you see the smile.
story.share: You say you would like to be the one. "Then do not telegraph it," Vesper says.

mentors.name: Ysolde Marrow
mentors.title: The Legend Scholar
mentors.background: Spent forty years collecting stories of legendary Pokémon. Believes each myth hides one true fact.
mentors.personality: Hushed, reverent and stubborn about sources.
mentors.specialty: Myths, legends and the places they sleep.
mentors.weakness: Teaches almost nothing about ordinary battles.
mentors.unlockText: Reach trust 40 with Dr. Linden Vale.
mentors.teaching: Legend lore: where legendaries sleep and how to meet them.

lessons.name: Read the Myth
lessons.text: Every legend names its own resting place.

lessons.name: Signs of the Old Ones
lessons.text: The ground remembers what the sky forgot.

lessons.name: The Covenant
lessons.text: To meet a legend you must be worth meeting. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: The Archive Key
lessons.text: A graduate is given the archive's key.

lines.greet: Quiet. The old ones listen better than people do.
lines.praise: Yes. That is what the third scroll said.
lines.scold: You forgot the source. Always the source.
lines.disagree: Stories are not instructions. But they are not nothing.
lines.graduate: You will see what I only wrote about. Remember me.

mission.name: The Third Scroll
mission.text: Clear 2 gyms while following the scholar's notes.

graduation.title: Marrow's Keeper
graduation.text: Ysolde gives you the archive's key, still warm.

story.intro: Ysolde unrolls a map. "I saw one once, for three seconds, in a storm. I have written four hundred pages since to be sure I did not dream it."
story.listen: You look at the map without a word.
story.share: You tell her about a strange dream. She reaches for her pen.

mentors.name: Tobias Satchel
mentors.title: The Satchel Sage
mentors.background: A pedlar who stocked a hundred adventurers and learned what each one forgot to pack.
mentors.weakness: Always has a scheme; not all of them work.
mentors.teaching: Item craft: better shops, better stock, better Bag.

lessons.name: Pack Light
lessons.text: Carry what saves you twice.

lessons.name: The Art of the Haggle
lessons.text: A shop price is an opening offer.

lessons.name: Hold It Right
lessons.text: The right item in the right paw. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: The Hidden Stash
lessons.text: Graduates know where the spare pack is.

lines.greet: Everything has a price. The good stuff has two.
lines.praise: You used that item perfectly. I would have charged for that.
lines.scold: You wasted it! That was premium!
lines.disagree: You can sell sentiment; you cannot eat it.
lines.graduate: No charge. This one is on me.

mission.name: The Long Delivery
mission.text: Reach 2 badges and keep the stock unspoiled.

graduation.title: Satchel's Partner
graduation.text: Tobias slides his battered satchel across the counter.

story.intro: Tobias pats the satchel. "My first customer was a girl with no money and a Pokémon with no berries. I gave her both. Worst deal I ever made."
story.listen: You smile and let him ramble.
story.share: You offer to pay for something small. He refuses, and then accepts.

mentors.name: Fenwick Eon
mentors.title: The Evolution Tutor
mentors.background: Believes every Pokémon is halfway to something else. Tracks evolution lines on a wall of string.
mentors.weakness: Frets over every Pokémon that has not evolved yet.
mentors.teaching: Evolution craft: earlier evolutions and stronger forms.

lessons.name: Almost There
lessons.text: Growing is a quiet kind of brave.

lessons.name: The Bond Stone
lessons.text: Some forms only wake to friendship.

lessons.name: The Final Form
lessons.text: The last stage is the first stage, understood. (and a move to remember it by)

lessons.name: The String Wall
lessons.text: Graduates get a thread of their own.

lines.greet: There is a form in there. Be patient with it.
lines.praise: Oh! It is starting. Do you see?
lines.scold: You skipped a stage. Stages matter.
lines.disagree: Faster is not wiser. Wait for the light.
lines.graduate: Every one of us is halfway to something. Go and find yours.

mission.name: The Final Stage
mission.text: Win 2 gym badges before your team finishes growing.

graduation.title: Eon's Heir
graduation.text: Fenwick ties a piece of string to your wrist.

story.intro: Fenwick touches the string on the wall. "My Eevee never evolved. I used to think I failed it. Now I think it just did not need to."
story.listen: You sit beside him in silence.
story.share: You say your own team is still changing. "Good. Stay curious," he says.
